snippet.title: 🎞️ 𝗠𝗮𝗴𝗶𝗰 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗲 |  𝗚𝗹𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗹 𝗟𝗮𝘂𝗻𝗰𝗵 𝗢𝗽𝗲𝗻 – 𝗔 𝗡𝗲𝘄 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗕𝗲𝗴𝗶𝗻𝘀 🎞️
snippet.description:
🐾✨ One day, the cats discovered a mysterious glowing cauldron.
Following its light, a whole new world unfolded!

Gather ingredients, merge them, 
and something entirely fresh is created! ✨
With every recipe, their warm Share House grows a little bigger 🏠

And in that Share House, each cat brings its own unique charm!
What they wear, their personality, and abilities 
are entirely up to you, Magician! 🐾

💫 𝗠𝗮𝗴𝗶𝗰 𝗥𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗽𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗻𝗼𝘄 𝗹𝗮𝘂𝗻𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗴𝗹𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆!
The magical everyday life of these adorable cats begins now.
Search for '𝐌𝐚𝐠𝐢𝐜 𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐞' in the store 🔗

If you're excited for the magic ahead,
leave a purple heart 💜 in the comments!



⚠️ Magic Recipe is currently available in most countries.
Service in some countries is still being prepared.

#MagicRecipe #CatsAndSoupSequel #CatGame #GlobalLaunch #Release
